question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The more harder / you work, / the better / it will be.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'The more harder'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'The harder' **should be used instead of **'The more harder'.**
 
• Using** double comparatives **is an error.
 
 
• *Example: Emma is **smarter** than Jason.*
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

​**Correct Sentence:__** ***The harder** you work, the better it will be.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ **'The more harder'** के स्थान पर **'The harder' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• '**Double comparatives**' का उपयोग करना एक **error** है।
 
 
• ​*Example: Emma is smarter than Jason.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर** Option 1 **है।
